sentence: From 2022-02-22 to 2026-11-20 (239 weekly decisions, both traded at the open), labels set with the pre-market price returned +32.6% a year (worst drawdown -41.1%) against +35.4% (-42.1%) for labels set at the previous close; the two agreed on 89% of stock-weeks. Sharpe ratio difference -0.05 (95% block-bootstrap CI [-0.18, +0.07]): deciding before the open has been **not distinguishable from deciding on the previous close**.
